parameters.name: CheckId
parameters.description:
The ID of the check item.

> You can call the [ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~) operation to obtain the ID of the check item.

parameters.name: CheckIds
parameters.description: The list of IDs of the check items.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The list of instance IDs of the assets affected by the check item.

parameters.name: TaskSource
parameters.description:
The source of the task. Valid values:

- **YAO_CHI**: YaoChi console.
